output.summary: A very spiny tree native to eastern and northeastern Africa and the Arabian Peninsula. Cuts in its bark release fragrant resin that dries into small clumps, while its flaky outer bark can be silvery, reddish or bluish-grey over green inner bark. The resin is used to flavour meat products, desserts, soft drinks, gum and sweets.
